projects.title: Human-in-the-Loop Approval System — Copilot Studio, Teams & Outlook
projects.description: End-to-end approval system built in Copilot Studio. Employee raises request via chat → Teams + Outlook dual notification → Approver one-click decision → Manager confirmation → SharePoint List stores outcome with T1/T2/T3 timestamps to calculate turnaround time at every handoff.

components.text: Copilot Studio bot collects the request, Power Automate sends Teams Adaptive Card + Outlook email to the approver, manager gives final confirmation, and SharePoint List stores the full record with timestamps T1 (raised), T2 (notified), T3 (confirmed) to track approval interval at each handoff stage.
